name: Overhaul
desc: Immediately raze all of your fences, add up to 3 fences from your supply, and rebuild them. (You do not lose any animals during this.)

name: Stable
desc: Immediately build 1 stable. (The stable costs you nothing, but you must pay the cost shown on this card.)

name: Carriage Trip
desc: If you play this card in the work phase, you can immediately place another person.

name: Writing Boards
desc: You immediately get 1 <WOOD> for each occupation you have in front of you.

name: Remodeling
desc: You immediately get 1 <CLAY> for each clay room and for each major improvement you have.

name: Stone Clearing
desc: Immediately place 1 <STONE> on each of your empty fields. Harvest them during the next field phase. These fields are considered planted until then.

name: Blade Shears
desc: You immediately get your choice of 3 <FOOD>, or 1 <FOOD> for each sheep you have. (Keep the sheep.)

name: Plant Fertilizer
desc: In each field with exactly 1 good, you can immediately place 1 additional good of the same type.

name: Automatic Water Trough
desc: If you can accommodate the animal, you can immediately buy 1 <SHEEP>/<PIG>/<CATTLE> for 0/1/2 <FOOD>.

name: Bunk Beds
desc: Once you have 4 rooms, your house can hold 5 people.

name: Wildlife Reserve
desc: This card can hold up to 1 <SHEEP>, 1 <PIG>, and 1 <CATTLE>.

name: Cattle Farm
desc: For each pasture you have, you can keep 1 <CATTLE> on this card.

name: Wood Slide Hammer
desc: On your first renovation, if you have at least 5 wood rooms, you can renovate to stone directly and you get a discount of 2 <STONE> on the renovation cost.

name: Straw-Thatched Roof
desc: You no longer need <REED> to renovate or build a room.

name: Trellis
desc: Each time before you use the __Pig Market__ accumulation space, you can take a __Build Fences__ action. (You must pay <WOOD> for the fences as usual.)

name: Field Fences
desc: You can immediately take a __Build Fences__ action, during which you do not have to pay <WOOD> for fences that you build next to field tiles.

name: Newly-Plowed Field
desc: When you play this card, you can immediately plow 1 field, which needs not be adjacent to another field.

name: Roll-Over Plow
desc: At any time, if you have at least 3 planted fields, you can discard all goods from one of those fields to plow 1 field.

name: Swing Plow
desc: Place 4 field tiles on this card. Each time you use the __Farmland__ action space, you can also plow up to 2 fields from this card.

name: Mole Plow
desc: Each time you use the __Farmland__ or __Cultivation__ action space, you can plow 1 additional field.

name: Heart of Stone
desc: Each time a __Quarry__ accumulation space is revealed, if you have room in your house, you can immediately take a __Family Growth__ action without placing a person.

name: Basket Chair
desc: When you play this card, you can immediately move the first person (unless it is on the __Meeting Place__ action space) you placed this work phase to this card. If you do, immediately afterward, you can place another person.

name: Job Contract
desc: If both are unoccupied, you can use the __Day Laborer__ and the adjacent __Lessons__ action space with a single person (in that order). Afterward, both spaces are considered occupied.

name: Bed in the Grain Field
desc: At the start of the next harvest, you get a __Family Growth__ action if you have room for the newborn.

name: Steam Machine
desc: Each work phase, if the last action space you use is an accumulation space, you can immediately afterward take a __Bake Bread__ action.

name: Flail
desc: When you play this card, you immediately get 2 <FOOD>. Each time you use the __Farmland__ or __Cultivation__ action space, you can also take a __Bake Bread__ action.

name: Blueprint
desc: You can build the major improvements __Joinery__, __Pottery__, and __Basketmaker\'s Workshop__ even when taking a __Minor Improvement__ action. They each cost you 1 <STONE> less.

name: Teacher's Desk
desc: Each time you use the __Major Improvement__ or __House Redevelopment__ action space, you can also play 1 occupation at an occupation cost of 1 <FOOD>.

name: Beer Table
desc: At the end of the field phase of each harvest, you can pay 1 <GRAIN> from your supply to get 2 bonus <SCORE>. If you do, all other players get 1 <FOOD> each.

name: Half-Timbered House
desc: During scoring, you get 1 bonus <SCORE> for each stone room you have. You can only use one card to get bonus points for your stone house.

name: Writing Chamber
desc: During scoring, you get a number of bonus <SCORE> equal to the total of negative points you have, to a maximum of 7 <SCORE>.

name: Abort Oriel
desc: You can no longer play this card when any player (including you) has 5 or more cards in front of them.

name: Greening Plan
desc: During scoring, if you then have at least 2/4/5/6 unplanted fields, you get 1/2/3/5 bonus <SCORE>.

name: Elephantgrass Plant
desc: Immediately after each harvest, you can use this card to exchange exactly 1 <REED> for 1 bonus <SCORE>.

name: Lantern House
desc: During scoring, you get 1 negative <SCORE> for each card left in your hand. You cannot discard cards from your hand unplayed. If you already have, you cannot play this card.

name: Clay Deposit
desc: Immediately after each time you use a clay accumulation space, you can exchange 1 <CLAY> for 1 bonus <SCORE>. If you do, place the <CLAY> on the accumulation space.

name: Dwelling Mound
desc: From now on, you must pay 1 <FOOD> for each new field tile that you place in your farmyard.

name: Christianity
desc: When you play this card, all other players get 1 <FOOD> each.

name: Studio Boat
desc: Each time you use the __Traveling Players__ accumulation space, you also get 1 bonus <SCORE>. In games with 1-3 players, this card is considered __Traveling Players__ (same effect as __Fishing__).

name: Canvas Sack
desc: When you play this card paying <GRAIN>/<REED> for it, you immediately get 1 <VEGETABLE>/4 <WOOD>.

name: Farm Store
desc: After the feeding phase of each harvest, you can exchange exactly 1 <FOOD> for 2 different building resources of your choice or 1 <VEGETABLE>.

name: Ravenous Hunger
desc: Immediately after each time you use the __Vegetable Seeds__ action space, you can place another person on an accumulation space and get 1 additional good of the accumulating type.

name: Farm Building
desc: Each time you build a major improvement, place 1 <FOOD> on each of the next 3 round spaces. At the start of these rounds, you get the <FOOD>.

name: Chicken Coop
desc: Place 1 <FOOD> on each of the next 8 round spaces. At the start of these rounds, you get the <FOOD>.

name: Stew
desc: Each time you use the __Day Laborer__ action space, also place 1 <FOOD> on each of the next 4 round spaces. At the start of these rounds, you get the <FOOD>.

name: Mandoline
desc: Once per round, you can pay 1 <VEGETABLE> to get 1 bonus <SCORE>. If you do, place 1 <FOOD> on each of the next 2 round spaces. At the start of these rounds, you get the <FOOD>.

name: Garden Claw
desc: Place 1 <FOOD> on each remaining round space, up to three times the number of planted fields you have. At the start of these rounds, you get the <FOOD>.

name: Farmstead
desc: After each turn in which you make at least one unused farmyard space used, you get 1 food.

name: Beer Stall
desc: In the feeding phase of each harvest, for each empty unfenced stable you have, you can exchange 1 <GRAIN> for 5 <FOOD>.

name: Stable Yard
desc: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <FOOD> for each completed round left to play. At any time, you can exchange 1 <SHEEP> plus 1 <PIG> for 1 <CATTLE>.

name: Fishing Net
desc: Each time another player uses the __Fishing__ accumulation space, they must first pay you 1 <FOOD>. Then, in the returning home phase of that round, place 2 <FOOD> on __Fishing__.

name: Huntsman's Hat
desc: For each new <PIG> you get from the effect of an action space, you also get 1 <FOOD>.

name: Gypsy's Crock
desc: Each time you use a cooking improvement to turn 2 goods into <FOOD> at the same time, you get 1 additional <FOOD>.

name: Market Stall
desc: After the field phase of each harvest, you can exchange 1 <GRAIN> plus 1 <FENCE> (both from your supply) for 5 <FOOD>.

name: Studio
desc: In the feeding phase of each harvest, you can use this card to turn exactly 1 <WOOD>/<CLAY>/<STONE> into 2/2/3 <FOOD>.

name: Feed Fence
desc: For each new stable you build, you get 1 <FOOD> —for your last one, get 3 <FOOD>. Each time you build stables, you can build exactly 1 stable for 1 <CLAY> instead of 2 <WOOD>.

name: Crudité
desc: When you play this card, you can immediately buy exactly 1 <VEGETABLE> for 3 <FOOD>. At any time, you can discard 1 <VEGETABLE> on top of another <VEGETABLE> in a field to get 4 <FOOD>.

name: Woodcraft
desc: Each time you use a wood accumulation space, if immediately afterward you have at most 5 <WOOD> in your supply, you get 1 <FOOD>.

name: Schnapps Distillery
desc: In each feeding phase, you can use this card to turn exactly 1 <VEGETABLE> into 5 <FOOD>. During scoring, you get 1 bonus <SCORE> each for your 5th and 6th <VEGETABLE>.

name: Small Potters Oven
desc: When you play this card, you immediately get 5 food. Each time before you get a __Bake Bread__ action, you can build the "Clay Oven" or "stone Oven" major improvement.

name: Beer Stein
desc: Each time you take a __Bake Bread__ action, you can use this card once to turn 1 <GRAIN> into 2 <FOOD> and 1 bonus <SCORE>.

name: Cooking Hearth Extension
desc: Each harvest, you can use each of your cooking improvements once to get double the amount of food for 1 animal or vegetable.

name: Craft Brewery
desc: In the feeding phase of each harvest, you can use this card to exchange 1 <GRAIN> from your supply plus 1 <GRAIN> from a field for 2 bonus <SCORE> and 4 <FOOD>.

name: Corn Schnapps Distillery
desc: Once per round, you can pay 1 <GRAIN> to place 1 <FOOD> on each of the next 4 round spaces. At the start of these rounds, you get the <FOOD>.

name: Granary
desc: Place 1 <GRAIN> each on the remaining spaces for rounds 8, 10, and 12. At the start of these rounds, you get the <GRAIN>.

name: Eternal Rye Cultivation
desc: After each harvest in which you have 2 or 3+ <GRAIN> in your supply, you get 1 <FOOD> and 1 additional <GRAIN>, respectively.

name: Mineral Feeder
desc: At the start of each round that does not end with a harvest, if you have at least 1 <SHEEP> in a pasture, you get 1 <GRAIN>.

name: Bookcase
desc: Each time after you play an occupation, you get 1 <VEGETABLE>.

name: Land Consolidation
desc: At any time, you can exchange 3 grain in a field for 1 vegetable in that field.

name: Lettuce Patch
desc: This card is a field that can only grow vegetables. You can immediately turn each <VEGETABLE> you harvested from this card into 4 <FOOD>.

name: Slurry
desc: In the breeding phase of each harvest, if you get newborn animals of at least two types, you also get a __Sow__ action.

name: Slurry Spreader
desc: In the breeding phase of each harvest, if you get newborn animals of at least two types, you also get a __Sow__ action.

name: Harvest Festival Planning
desc: When you play this card, immediately carry out the field phase of the harvest. Afterwards, you get a "Major or Minor Improvement" action.

name: Seaweed Fertilizer
desc: Each time after you take an unconditional __Sow__ action, you get 1 <GRAIN> from the general supply. From round 11 on, you can get 1 <VEGETABLE> instead.

name: Private Forest
desc: Place 1 <WOOD> on each remaining even-numbered round space. At the start of these rounds, you get the <WOOD>.

name: Firewood
desc: UPDATED: In the returning home phase of each round, place 1 <WOOD> on this card. Each time after you build a Fireplace, Cooking Hearth, or oven, move up to 4 <WOOD> from this card to your supply.

name: Wood Cart
desc: Each time you use a wood accumulation space, you get 2 additional <WOOD>.

name: Clay Supply
desc: Place 1 <CLAY> on each of the next 3 round spaces. At the start of these rounds, you get the <CLAY>.

name: Reed-Hatted Toad
desc: Add 5, 7, 9, 11, and 13 to the current round and place 1 <REED> on each corresponding round space. At the start of these rounds, you get the <REED>.

name: Stone Cart
desc: Place 1 <STONE> on each remaining even-numbered round space. At the start of these rounds, you get the <STONE>.

name: Rocky Terrain
desc: Each time you plow a field (tile or card), you can also buy 1 <STONE> for 1 <FOOD>.

name: Material Hub
desc: Immediately place 2 of each building resource on this card. Each time any player (including you) takes at least 5 wood, 4 clay, 3 reed, or 3 stone, you get 1 of that building resource from this card.

name: Hardware Store
desc: Each time after you use the __Day Laborer__ action space, you can pay 2 <FOOD> total to buy 1 <WOOD>, 1 <CLAY>, 1 <REED>, and 1 <STONE>.

name: Early Cattle
desc: When you play this card, you immediately get 2 <CATTLE>.

name: Perennial Rye
desc: Each round that does not end with a harvest, you can pay 1 <GRAIN> to breed exactly 1 type of animal. (This is not considered a breeding phase.)

name: Den Builder
desc: When you live in a clay or stone house, you can pay 1 <GRAIN> and 2 <FOOD>. If you do, for the rest of the game, this card provides room for exactly one person.

name: Livestock Feeder
desc: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <GRAIN>. This card can hold 1 animal of any type for each <GRAIN> in your supply.

name: Mason
desc: Place a stone room on this card. Once you have a stone house with at least 4 rooms, at any time, you can add that room without paying any building resources.

name: Carpenter's Apprentice
desc: Wood rooms cost you 2 <WOOD> less. Your 3rd and 4th stable each cost you 1 <WOOD> less. Your 13th to 15th fence each cost you nothing.

name: Stable Master
desc: When you play this card, you can immediately build exactly 1 stable for 1 <WOOD>. Exactly one of your unfenced stables can hold up to 3 animals of one type.

name: Field Watchman
desc: Each time you use the __Grain Seeds__ action space, you can also plow 1 field.

name: Plow Hero
desc: Each time you use the __Farmland__ or __Cultivation__ action space with the first person you place in a round, you can plow 1 additional field for 1 <FOOD>.

name: Autumn Mother
desc: Immediately before each harvest, if you have room in your house, you can take a __Family Growth__ action for 3 <FOOD>.

name: Inner Districts Director
desc: Each time you use the __Forest__ or __Clay Pit__ accumulation space, you can place 1 <STONE> from the general supply on the other space. If you do, you can immediately place another person.

name: Stable Cleaner
desc: At any time, you can take the __Build Stables__ action without placing a person. If you do, each stable costs you 1 <WOOD> and 1 <FOOD>.

name: Basket Weaver
desc: When you play this card, immediately build the __Basketmaker\'s Workshop__ major improvement for 1 <STONE> and 1 <REED>.

name: Merchant
desc: Immediately after each time you take a __Major or Minor Improvement__ or __Minor Improvement__ action, you can pay 1 <FOOD> to take the action a second time.

name: Seed Researcher
desc: Each time any people return from both the __Grain Seeds__ and __Vegetable Seeds__ action spaces, you get 2 <FOOD> and you can play 1 occupation, without paying an occupation cost.

name: Cube Cutter
desc: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <WOOD>. In the field phase of each harvest, you can use this card to exchange exactly 1 <WOOD> and 1 <FOOD> for 1 bonus <SCORE>.

name: Garden Designer
desc: At the start of scoring, you can place <FOOD> in empty fields. You get 1/2/3 bonus <SCORE> for each field in which you place 1/4/7 <FOOD>.

name: Butler
desc: If you play this card in round 11 or before, during scoring, you get 4 bonus <SCORE> if you then have more rooms than people.

name: Stall Holder
desc: Once per round, if you have 0/1/2/3/4 unfenced stables on your farm, you can exchange 2 <GRAIN> for 1 bonus <SCORE> and 1/2/3/4/5 <FOOD>.

name: Tree Guard
desc: Each time after you use a wood accumulation space, you can place 4 <WOOD> from your supply on that space to get 2 <STONE>, 1 <CLAY>, 1 <REED>, and 1 <GRAIN>.

name: Green Grocer
desc: At the start of each round, you can make exactly one of the following exchanges: 1 <CATTLE> <ARROW> 1 <VEGETABLE>; 1 <VEGETABLE> <ARROW> 1 <CATTLE>; 2 <SHEEP> <ARROW> 1 <VEGETABLE>; 1 <VEGETABLE> <ARROW> 2 <SHEEP>; 2 <FOOD> <ARROW> 1 <GRAIN>; 1 <GRAIN> <ARROW> 2 <FOOD>

name: Collector
desc: This card is an action space for you only. When you use it for the 1st/2nd/3rd/4th time, you get 1 <BEGGING> marker and 6/7/8/9 different good of your choice.

name: Basket Carrier
desc: Once each harvest, you can buy 1 <WOOD>, 1 <REED>, and 1 <GRAIN> for 2 <FOOD> total.

name: Potato Harvester
desc: When you play this card, you immediately get 3 <FOOD>. For each <VEGETABLE> you get from your fields during the field phase of the harvest, you get 1 additional <FOOD>.

name: Baker
desc: When you play this card and at the start of each feeding phase, you can take a __Bake Bread__ action.

name: Layabout
desc: When you play this card, you must skip the next harvest. (You also do not have to feed your family that harvest.)

name: Schnapps Distiller
desc: In the feeding phase of each harvest, you can use this card to turn exactly 1 <VEGETABLE> into 5 <FOOD>.

name: Home Brewer
desc: After the field phase of each harvest, you can use this card to turn exactly 1 <GRAIN> into your choice of 3 <FOOD> or 1 bonus <SCORE>.

name: Small Animal Breeder
desc: Before the start of each round, if you have <FOOD> equal to or higher than the upcoming round number (e.g., 8+ <FOOD> before round 8), you get 1 <FOOD>.

name: Thresher
desc: Immediately before each time you use the __Grain Utilization__, __Farmland__, or __Cultivation__ action space, you can buy 1 <GRAIN> for 1 <FOOD>.

name: Winter Caretaker
desc: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <GRAIN>. At the end of each harvest, you can buy exactly 1 <VEGETABLE> for 2 <FOOD>.

name: Soil Scientist
desc: Each time after you use a clay/stone accumulation space, you can place 1 <STONE>/2 <CLAY> from your supply on the space to get 2 <GRAIN>/1 <VEGETABLE>, respectively.

name: Sower
desc: Each time you build a major improvement, place 1 <REED> from the general supply on this card. At any time, you can move the <REED> to your supply or exchange it for a __Sow__ action.

name: Furniture Maker
desc: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <WOOD>. Each time you play an occupation after this one, you get 1 <WOOD> for each <FOOD> paid as occupation cost.

name: Legworker
desc: Each time you use an action space that is orthogonally adjacent to another action space occupied by one of your people, you get 1 wood.

name: Wood Collector
desc: Place 1 <WOOD> on each of the next 5 round spaces. At the start of these rounds, you get the <WOOD>.

name: Skillful Renovator
desc: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <WOOD> and 1 <CLAY>. Each time after you renovate, you get a number of <WOOD> equal to the number of people you placed that round.

name: Agricultural Labourer
desc: Place 8 <CLAY> on this card. For each <GRAIN> you obtain, you also get 1 <CLAY> from this card.

name: Clay Kneader
desc: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <WOOD> and 2 <CLAY>. Each time after you use __Grain Seeds__ or __Vegetable Seeds__ action space, you get 1 <CLAY>.

name: Bricklayer
desc: Each improvement and each renovation cost you 1 <CLAY> less. Each room costs you 2 <CLAY> less.

name: Freemason
desc: As long as you live in a <CLAY>/<STONE> house with exactly 2 rooms, at the start of each work phase, you get 2 <CLAY>/<STONE>.

name: Stone Importer
desc: In the breeding phase of the 1st/2nd/3rd/4th/5th/6th harvest, you can use this card to buy exactly 2 <STONE> for 2/2/3/3/4/1 <FOOD>.

name: Nightworker
desc: Before the start of each work phase, you can place a person on an accumulation space of a building resource not in your supply. (Then proceed with the start player.)

name: Excavator
desc: Each time after you use the __Day Laborer__ action space, you get 1 additional <WOOD> and <CLAY>, and you can buy 1 <STONE> for 1 <FOOD>.

name: Lover
desc: When you play this card, immediately pay an amount of <FOOD> equal to the number of complete rounds left to play to take a __Family Growth Even without Room__ action.

name: Wooden Hut Extender
desc: Wood rooms now cost you 1 <REED>, and additionally 5 <WOOD> through round 5, 4 <WOOD>  in rounds 6 and 7, and 3 <WOOD>  in round 8 and later.

name: Second Spouse
desc: You can use the __Urgent Wish for Children__ action space (from round 12-13) even if it is occupied by the first person another player placed.

name: Outskirts Director
desc: Each time you use the __Grove__ or __Hollow__ accumulation space, you can place 2 <REED> from the general supply on the other space. If you do, you can immediately place another person.

name: Private Teacher
desc: Each time you use the __Grain Seeds__ action space when any __Lessons__ action space is occupied, you can also play an occupation for an occupation cost of 1 <FOOD>.

name: Timber Shingle Maker
desc: When you renovate to stone, you can place up to 1 <WOOD> from your supply in each of your rooms. During scoring, each such <WOOD> is worth 1 bonus <SCORE>.

name: Soldier
desc: During scoring, you get 1 bonus <SCORE> for each <STONE> + <WOOD> pair in your supply. You cannot score additional points for the resources scored with this card.

name: Cow Prince
desc: During scoring, you get 1 bonus <SCORE> for each space in your farmyard (including rooms) holding at least 1 <CATTLE>.

name: Constable
desc: If there are still 1/3/6/9 complete rounds left to play, you immediately get 1/2/3/4 <WOOD>. During scoring, each player with no negative points in any scoring line gets 3 bonus <SCORE>.

name: Ranch Provost
desc: If there are still 3/6/9 complete rounds left to play, you immediately get 2/3/4 <WOOD>. During scoring, each player with a pasture of highest capacity gets 3 bonus <SCORE>.

name: Charcoal Burner
desc: Each time any player (including you) plays or builds a <BAKE>-improvement, you get 1 <WOOD> and 1 <FOOD>.

name: Animal Feeder
desc: On the __Day Laborer__ action space, you also get your choice of 1 <SHEEP> or 1 <GRAIN>. Instead of that good, you can buy 1 <PIG> for 1 <FOOD> or 1 <CATTLE> for 2 <FOOD>.

name: Basketmaker's Wife
desc: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <REED> and 1 <FOOD>. At any time, you can turn 1 <REED> into 2 <FOOD>.

name: Packaging Artist
desc: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <GRAIN>. Each time you get a __Minor Improvement__ action, you can take a __Bake Bread__ action instead.

name: Sheep Provider
desc: Each time any player (including you) uses the __Sheep Market__ accumulation space, you get 1 <GRAIN>.

name: Market Crier
desc: Each time you use the __Grain Seeds__ action space, you can get an additional 1 <GRAIN> and 1 <VEGETABLE>. If you do, each other player gets 1 <GRAIN>.

name: Stone Buyer
desc: When you play this card, you can immediately buy exactly 2 <STONE> for 1 <FOOD>. From the next round on, once per round, you can buy 1 <STONE> for 2 <FOOD>.

name: Reed Roof Renovator
desc: Each time another player renovates, you immediately get 1 <REED> from the general supply. When you play this card in a 3-player game, you immediately get 1 <REED>.

name: Forest Reviewer
desc: Each time after any player (including you) uses the unoccupied __Grove__ or __Forest__ accumulation space while the other of the two is occupied, you get 1 <REED>.

name: Workshop Assistant
desc: Place a unique pair of different building resources on each of your improvements. Each time another player renovates, you may move one such pair to your supply.

name: Cowherd
desc: Each time you use the __Cattle Market__ accumulation space, you get 1 additional <CATTLE>.

name: Mud Wallower
desc: Every fourth time you use an accumulation space, you get 1 <PIG>, held by this card.

name: Resource Recycler
desc: Each time another player renovates to stone, if you live in a clay house, you can pay 2 <FOOD> to build a clay room at no additional cost.

name: Parrot Breeder
desc: On your turn, if you pay 1 <GRAIN> to the general supply, you can use the same action space (unless it is the __Meeting Place__ action space) that the player to your right has just used on their turn (not retroactive).

name: Sowing Director
desc: Each time after another player uses the __Grain Utilization__ action space, you get a __Sow__ action.

name: Puppeteer
desc: Each time another player uses the __Traveling Players__ accumulation space, you can pay them 1 <FOOD> to immediately play an occupation without paying an occupation cost.

name: Pattern Maker
desc: Each time another player renovates, you can exchange exactly 2 <WOOD> for 1 <GRAIN>, 1 <FOOD>, and 1 bonus <SCORE>.

name: Twin Researcher
desc: Each time you use one of the two accumulation spaces for the same type of good containing exactly the same number of goods, you can also buy 1 bonus <SCORE> for 1 <FOOD>.

name: Food Distributor
desc: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <GRAIN> and, at the start of this returning home phase, an amount of <FOOD> equal to the number of occupied Round 1-14 action spaces.

name: Hoof Caregiver
desc: Immediately add 1 <CATTLE> from the general supply to the __Cattle Market__ accumulation space. Afterward, for each cattle on __Cattle Market__, you get 1 <GRAIN> plus 1 <FOOD>.

name: Resource Analyzer
desc: Before the start of each round, if you have more building resources than all other players of at least two types, you get 1 <FOOD>.

name: Forest Campaigner
desc: Each time before you place a person, if there are at least 8 <WOOD> total on accumulation spaces, you get 1 <FOOD>.

name: Fisherman's Friend
desc: At the start of each round, if there is more <FOOD> on the __Traveling Players__ than on the __Fishing__ accumulation space, you get the difference from the general supply.

name: Outrider
desc: Each time before you use the action space on the most recently revealed action space card (after it has been placed on the round space), you get 1 <GRAIN>.

name: Potato Digger
desc: When you play this card, if you have at least 2/4/5 unplanted field tiles, you immediately get 1/2/3 <VEGETABLE>.

name: Forest Owner
desc: This card is an action space for all. If another player uses it, they get 3 <WOOD> and must give you 1 <WOOD> from the general supply. If you use it, you get 4 <WOOD>.

name: Material Deliveryman
desc: Each time any player (including you) takes 5/6/7/8+ goods from an accumulation space, you get 1 <WOOD>/<CLAY>/<REED>/<STONE> from the general supply.

name: German Heath Keeper
desc: Each time any player (including you) uses the __Pig Market__ accumulation space, you get 1 <SHEEP> from the general supply.

name: Game Catcher
desc: When you play this card, pay 1 <FOOD> for each remaining harvest to immediately get 1 <CATTLE> and 1 <PIG>.

name: Cattle Whisperer
desc: Add 5 and 8 to the current round and place 1 <CATTLE> on each corresponding round space. At the start of these rounds, you get the <CATTLE>.

name: Cattle Buyer
desc: Each time another player uses the __Fencing__ action space, you can buy exactly 1 <SHEEP>/<PIG>/<CATTLE> from the general supply for 1/2/2 <FOOD>.

name: Animal Catcher
desc: Each time you use the __Day Laborer__ action space, instead of 2 <FOOD>, you can get 3 different animals from the general supply. If you do, you must pay 1 <FOOD> each harvest left to play.

name: Fast Mason
desc: Immediately after each time you use a clay/stone accumulation space, you can renovate your house to clay/stone without paying reed.

name: Amateur Fencer
desc: When you play this card, if you have no pastures yet, you can immediately fence exactly 1 space in your farmyard without paying wood for the fences.

name: Young Artist
desc: In the returning home phase of each round, you can pay 1 food to either take a "Minor Improvement" action or to draw 2 new minor improvements.

name: Field Counter
desc: Each time another player plows a field, place 1 food on this card. Once this game, you can turn this card face down to get the food on it.

name: Top Outer
desc: Each time the "House Building" action space on the game board extension is used, you get all of the food from the "Traveling Players" accumulation space.

name: Stone Custodian
desc: At the end of each work phase, if 1 stone accumulation space has stone left, you get 1 grain If 2 stone accumulation spaces have stone left, you get 1 vegetable instead.

name: Village Teacher
desc: Immediately after each time you use a "Lessons" action space, if this is the 1st/2nd/3rd occupied Lessons action space that round, you get 1 food/grain/vegetable.

name: Cleanacre
desc: Each time you use the "Farmland", "Cultivation", or "Farming Supplies" action (the latter only being available with 6 players), you also get 2 clay.

name: Mountain Hiker
desc: Immediately after each time you use an accumulation space on the game board extension, you can buy 1 stone for 1 food.

name: On Site Reverend
desc: At the start of each harvest, you get 1 building resource of your choice.

name: Bovine Pioneer
desc: Each time you create at least one new pasture from unfenced farmyard spaces you get 1 cattle.

name: Trapper
desc: Each time after you use a wood accumulation space, if this is the 2nd/3rd/4th occupied wood accumulation space that round, you can buy 1 sheep/wild boar/cattle for 1 food.
